## About
Stephen Terry Services started as a small, family-run pest control company serving the Greater Houston area. We still run it like a family business: honest work, fair prices, no gimmicks and no hidden fees.
Our licensed technicians handle bed bugs, fleas, German roaches, mosquitoes, rodents, termites and general pests. We now offer insulation services too, and we're building out an HVAC division to help keep your home comfortable.
If you need roofing work, Stephen's sons Ethan and Tyler Terry run Upscale Roofing with the same family values.

## Services
- Pest control: Treatment for bed bugs, fleas, German roaches, mosquitoes, rodents, termites and general pests, for homes and businesses.
- Termite and rodent inspections: A free inspection when you're looking at rodent exclusion or termite control. (Free inspection)
- Insulation: One customer had our crew clear out their attic, sanitize it and add the insulation it needed.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free inspections?
A: Yes. We offer a free inspection for rodent exclusion or termite control.

Q: Do you do HVAC work?
A: Our HVAC division is still being built out. Give us a call to ask where things stand.

Q: How do I set up an appointment?
A: Call our office at (713) 477-0047 or book online, and we'll go over your questions and get you on the schedule.
